text:
Make drain and batch log lines that name a job also print the first line of that job's request and, for a job that has ended, its state (landed, rejected, failed, interrupted) and a one-line reason. Add a rule to the the person running Athena-agent defaults: before reporting any job's outcome, run `athena status <job>` (it already exists, per crates/athena-cli/src/main.rs) and quote the job id, request title and recorded state. Acceptance: (1) in a test batch where one job is rejected, one is interrupted and one is running, each log line shows the right title and state, so no line can be pinned on the wrong job; (2) the defaults text contains the rule; (3) the prompt token budget test and the boundary word test still pass.

Acceptance:
- The change is made as described: Three times (Oct 31, then twice on Nov 7) the the person running Athena's agent reported the wrong job's state after matching a drain or batch log line to a job by its id alone
- No unrelated behavior changes; the existing tests pass
- fmt, clippy and test pass

Files: crates/athena-cli/src/main.rs
